posts.zh:
dsh-vision#vision-route 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b25a1b30f618f337c2f5.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision#vision-route is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b25a1b30f618f337c2f5.html
